_comment: Template. ionix-adaptive-colors renders this against the current wallpaper and writes ~/.config/ionix/adaptive-colors/quickshell/theme.json, which install-default symlinks to ~/.config/quickshell/ionix/theme.json. ../../quickshell/theme.json is the same file with the Ionix palette baked in — that one is also what the start menu's theme picker reads for this theme's preview swatch, so it must stay valid JSON.

options._comment: Rendered under 'Theme options' at the bottom of the start menu's settings page, as a four-way picker rather than a switch — see the 'choices' form documented in config/Config.qml. The value is stored in settings.json under themes.ionix-adaptive.barPosition. 'top' carries no patch because the shipped default already is the top edge; the other three set bar.position, which modules/Bar.qml keys the whole layout off. left/right turn the bar into a vertical dock and every module stacks and re-anchors itself, so nothing else has to be respelled here. The patch merges above this file but below settings.json and config.json, so a bar.position set by hand in config.json wins and the page then shows this row pinned instead of offering a picker that does nothing.
options.title: Bar position
options.subtitle: Which screen edge the bar docks to

theme._comment: Exactly the keys config/Theme.qml reads, and no more. barFill, panelFill, pillFill, pillBorder, barBorder, panelBorder and divider are all derived from these inside Theme.qml — emitting them here would freeze relationships the shell is meant to compute. accentBright is the load-bearing one: barBorder and panelBorder are both alpha() of it. The font keys are deliberately absent so they inherit the shipped Nerd Font, which every module renders its glyphs with.
